title: KGCache: Amortized Subgraph Retrieval for KG Reasoning with LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2608.07954v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models can answer knowledge-intensive questions more reliably when they are grounded with knowledge graphs, but systems such as Think-on-Graph and Reasoning-on-Graph repeatedly query the same graph neighborhoods across different questions. In this work, we study this repeated retrieval in Knowledge Graph Question Answering~(KGQA) workloads and propose KGCache, an in-memory cache for one-hop knowledge graph neighborhoods. KGCache is designed to be compatible with both iterative traversal (ToG) and one shot planning (RoG) KGQA paradigms. KGCache is placed between the KGQA engine and the backend serving the KG, so repeated entity requests can be served from cache instead of issuing new KG queries. We evaluate KGCache on WebQSP and CWQ using LRU, LFU, and a trace-aware Oracle policy. translated_abstract: 大语言模型在结合知识图谱进行增强后，能够更可靠地回答知识密集型问题，但诸如 Think-on-Graph 和 Reasoning-on-Graph 等系统在处理不同问题时会重复查询相同的图谱邻域。在这项工作中，我们研究了知识图谱问答（KGQA）工作负载中的这种重复检索现象，并提出了 KGCache——一个用于缓存一跳知识图谱邻域的内存缓存系统。KGCache 的设计同时兼容迭代式遍历（ToG）和一次性规划（RoG）两种 KGQA 范式。KGCache 被放置在 KGQA 引擎与提供知识图谱服务的后端之间，因此重复的实体请求可以直接由缓存提供服务，而无需发出新的知识图谱查询。我们在 WebQSP 和 CWQ 数据集上，使用 LRU、LFU 以及一种感知访问轨迹的 Oracle 策略对 KGCache 进行了评估。我们的分析表明，两个数据集在起始实体与遍历过程中访问到的实体之间存在大量的实体复用现象。我们还……
tldr: 该论文提出 KGCache，一个部署在 KGQA 引擎与知识图谱后端之间的一跳邻域内存缓存，通过利用跨问题的实体复用来摊销大语言模型知识图谱推理中重复的子图检索开销，并同时兼容 ToG 和 RoG 两种问答范式。
en_tdlr: KGCache is an in-memory cache of one-hop KG neighborhoods placed between the KGQA engine and the KG backend, which amortizes repeated subgraph retrieval in LLM-based KG reasoning by exploiting entity reuse across questions and supports both ToG and RoG paradigms.
